newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen CEO to retire in January 1998.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen CEO to retire in January 1998.

text.p: Walgreen Co. said Monday that Charles Walgreen III will retire as chief executive of the drugstore chain in January 1998 after more than 45 years of service.

L. Daniel Jorndt, president and chief operating officer, will assume the additional responsibility of CEO as of January. Walgreen will remain on the Deerfield, Ill.-based company's board and preside over board meetings.
During his tenure as CEO, Walgreens grew to 2,268 stores with 1996 sales of nearly $12 billion, from 618 stores and $800 million in sales in 1971.
Jorndt joined the company in 1963 and became president and chief operating officer in 1990.
Walgreen's stock fell 87.5 cents to $40.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
